text:
```yaml
name: Add Emojis

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      emoji:
        description: 'Emoji to add'
        required: true
        default: '🚀'

jobs:
  add-emojis:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Add emoji to README
        env:
          EMOJI: ${{ github.event.inputs.emoji }}
        run: |
          echo "$EMOJI" >> README.md
```
